entities.name: Ralph Grey, Baron Grey of Naunton

entities.summary: Ralph Francis Alnwick Grey, Baron Grey of Naunton, was a New Zealand peer who served as the last Governor of Northern Ireland. He was created a Life Peer as Baron Grey of Naunton on 17 September 1968.
